title: Honey Infused Hair Oil

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Hair Oil > Hair Styling & Treatments > Hair

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ All Hair Types✓ Good for: Dryness✓ allure 2023 Best of Beauty Award Winner✓ Increases Shine✓ Good for: Frizz

What it is: A luxurious hair oil enriched with the moisture binding Gisou Mirsalehi Honey to hydrate, boost shine, and smooth frizz and flyaways.


Hair Type: Fine, Medium, and Thick


Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily


Hair Concerns:

- Dryness

- Frizz

- Shine

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

As a finishing touch:

- Apply a few drops into your palms and rub your hands together until the product is dispersed throughout your palms and fingers.

- Use your fingers in a combing motion to evenly distribute the product from mid-lengths to ends, after styling on dry hair.


PRO TIPS:

As a moisture boost:

-Mix a few drops with the Gisou Honey Infused Hair Mask (sold separately) for an extra moisture.

-Mix well in hands and apply to towel-dried hair from root to tip.

-Leave in for five to seven minutes, then rinse thoroughly.


As an overnight treatment:

-Coat dry hair with two full droppers, adding more as needed for length and thickness.

-Fine and oily hair types should use one full dropper and focus on the ends.

-If the product isn’t fully absorbed in the morning, lightly rinse and shampoo.

Ingredients+

- Mirsalehi Honey: A powerhouse ingredient rich in vitamins, minerals, amino acids and potent antioxidants. Sustainably sourced from the Mirsalehi Bee Garden for six generations, it provides long lasting hydration and glossy shine.


- Bee Garden Oils: An 8-Oil blend, inspired by our Mirsalehi Bee Garden -  antioxidant powerhouse rich in Omega 3, 6 & 9 to deeply nourish the hair and lock in moisture. 


Honey Infused Hair Oil contains Tocopherol (Vitamin E), well-known for its antioxidant and UV protection benefits.


Dimethicone, Dimethiconol, Trisiloxane, Mirsalehi Honey, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Passiflora Incarnata Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Parfum (Fragrance), Gardenia Taitensis Flower Extract, CI 47000 (Yellow 11), Tocopherol, CI 26100 (Red 17), Coumarin, Hexyl Cinnamal, Limonene, Linalool.


The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
